fixed_config.candidate_selection: exact source selected and synthetically frozen before E1-v4 confirmation outcomes; no v5 tuning
fixed_config.method_order: parity counterbalanced by seed_index + rank_index + thread_index
fixed_config.test_policy: zero test evaluations in pilots; exactly one final test evaluation per method in each confirmation pair, after both methods finish training and all pre-test checks pass

implementation.incremental_kernel: allocation-free caller-owned ping-pong Aw/vz/4r-workspace same-vector out-kernel
implementation.refact_backend: fresh Cholesky, complete rewhitening, and two triangular solves on every non-refresh step

paired_diagnostics.interpretation: The two backends implement the same algebra in FP32, but a long nonlinear training trajectory need not be bit-identical. All numerical divergences are reported rather than filtered.
